MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "That's Christmas To Me connects my repeated Christmas listening with the group harmonies I enjoyed in Home Free's The New Old Fashioned, making it the strongest choice for this visit.",
    "It's the Girls! appeals to my interest in vocal-group repertoire, although that connection alone is not enough for me to choose it over the Christmas album today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Adele albums and Hozier do not give me the holiday songs or group harmonies I am looking for during this visit.",
    "Marty Robbins and Pure & Simple lean toward solo country, while Precious Memories: Vol. II offers hymns; neither connection captures what appeals to me about Home Free and my Christmas albums.",
    "Partners offers duets, but that is a weaker connection for me than the familiar vocal-group sound I currently want."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Home Free seems to have been taken as a broad interest in country singers, even though the group harmonies matter more to my choice today.",
    "My Christmas listening seems to have been stretched into an interest in hymns, which I would not automatically choose for the same reason."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several Christmas albums in my history make a holiday connection more compelling than a general connection to vocal music.",
    "The combination of Christmas songs and group harmonies matters most right now; sharing just one loose connection is less likely to make me interact."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You partly understood my interest in Christmas music and vocal groups, but stretched it too broadly into solo pop, country, and hymns."
}
